citations.narrative:
The facility did not follow the schedule in the written program of veterinary care (PVC) for sampling for intestinal parasites.
The written PVC indicates 10% of adult dogs must be tested for intestinal parasites (fecal testing) yearly. There were no
records of testing done on any adult dogs in 2025. The inspector called the attending veterinarian's clinic and they could
find no record of fecal testing performed at their clinic by the licensee in 2025. The facility owner could not recall
performing fecal testing in 2025 on breeding dogs maintained in the kennel and could not locate any record, invoice, or
other documentation of fecal testing performed on their regulated animals in 2025. Fecal screening tests for parasites are
an important aspect of maintaining the population health for breeding dogs. Correct by following the schedule for sampling
of parasites as approved by the attending veterinarian and written in the PVC. Additionally, licensees must maintain a
record of all sampling and treatments performed as described in 3.13(b)(4).
Correct as of 7/6/2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
